name: Earth
source: Pathfinder Rage of Elements, Earth adjustment (pg. 91), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=17
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Rage of Elements is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds the earth trait, tremorsense (imprecise) 60 feet, Petran (if it has languages) and a burrow Speed of 20 feet (40 feet at 8th level or higher).
optional: Optional: If it can cast spells, you can replace spells with earth spells of the same rank, such as: cantrip scatter scree, 1st pummeling rubble, 2nd exploding earth, 3rd one with stone, 4th mountain resilience, 5th wall of stone, 6th petrify, 7th heaving earth, 8th earthquake.
